Name: 24H Clock Language
Author: JoXW
Description:
[size=4][u]Important[/u][/size]

The mod is only tested in English, if issues with other languages are discovered they might not be fixable with this simple solution.

The all numeric measurements (such as fish sizes) will be incorrect when using English as the game converts values from imperial to metric for all languages except the default English one. The measurement  unit will still remain the same.

[u]﻿[size=4]Installation[/size][/u]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI
[*]Install the latest version of Content Patcher
[*]Extract into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods﻿[/b] folder or install using Vortex
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[size=4][u]Configuration/Setup
[/u][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Navigate to Mod languages menu
[*]Select "English" (This will be the same regardless of what language the mod is configured to use)
[*]Open [b][CP] 24H Clock Language[/b] in Generic Mod Config Menu, or open [b]config.json[/b] in [b]Stardew Valley/Mods﻿/[CP] 24H Clock Language [/b][size=1](If playing in English, no configuration should be required )[/size]
[*]Configure the language to your preferences (see ConfigSchema in [b]content.json[/b] for allowed values)
[*]Restart the game
[/list]
